name: winlogon-shell-win
description: Practice-box helper (Windows): appends a payload executable to the Winlogon Userinit value -- the attacker's process then runs inside every interactive logon, SYSTEM-adjacent, before the shell. Compiles a tiny placeholder .exe (the .NET Framework C# compiler ships on every Server box) that launches a hidden PowerShell payload, writes the payload script, and extends Userinit. The hardened state is Userinit back to exactly 'C:\Windows\system32\userinit.exe,'. Vars: PAYLOAD_PS1 (optional, default C:\ProgramData\Subsystems\winitupd.ps1); PAYLOAD_EXE (optional, default C:\ProgramData\Subsystems\winitupd.exe); PAYLOAD_BODY (optional). Pairs with a powershell_json check comparing Userinit to the stock value. Idempotent (append guarded).
